shortDescription: Manage ZFS boot environments on FreeBSD/Solaris/illumos systems

options.name: description
options.description: Associate a description with a new boot environment. This option is available only on Solarish platforms.

options.name: force
options.description: Specifies if the unmount should be forced.

options.name: mountpoint
options.description: Path where to mount the ZFS boot environment.

options.name: options
options.description: Create the datasets for new BE with specific ZFS properties. Multiple options can be specified. This option is available only on Solarish platforms.

options.name: snapshot
options.description: If specified, the new boot environment is cloned from the given snapshot or inactive boot environment.

options.name: state
options.description: Create or delete ZFS boot environment.
